svg.title: Vaginal discharge: history and speculum, then pH, whiff test and wet mount sort physiologic discharge and candidiasis (pH under 4.5) from bacterial vaginosis, trichomoniasis and atrophic vaginitis (pH over 4.5); tests, treatment, pregnancy and partner rules for each

svg.text: Vaginal discharge: physiologic, or which of four? pH → whiff → wet mount decide

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 · HISTORY: amount, colour, ODOUR, itch, sexual + Pap history → 2 · SPECULUM: swab the LATERAL walls, not the cervix

svg.text: 3 · pH strip, read WET → 4 · WHIFF: 10% KOH, fishy = amines → 5 · WET MOUNT: saline + KOH, low + high power

svg.text: physiologic: estrogen drives it (lots in pregnancy) · lactobacilli keep it acidic · colour charts are a guide only
